title: How Do Open Worlds Have No Loading Screens? 🎮 #GTA6 #shorts
description:
GTA 6 is out today. So how do open-world games show a giant world with no loading screens? The whole world won't fit in a console's memory, so games split the map into chunks and keep only the ones around you loaded. As you move, chunks ahead stream in from storage and the ones behind are thrown away. Far-away things use simpler, lower-detail versions of models. On fast SSDs, games can fetch what they need about a second before you need it, which is why speed is the real stress test: move fast enough and the world has to load faster than you arrive.

This explains how open-world games generally work, not the internals of any specific game.
